data.title: 由比滨结衣 · 清晨公园·林荫道旁的明媚笑容
data.description: 清晨公园的林荫大道上洒满斑驳树影，结衣牵着欢快小跑的家里的小狗萨布雷。看到迎面走来的你，她兴奋地用力挥舞手臂，元气满满的活力扑面而来——「早上好！竟然能在散步的时候偶遇，今天一定会有超棒的好运气吧！」
data.promptProse: Yui waves to the approaching viewer with her free hand while holding Sable’s leash in the other. Dappled morning light moves across her smile and the dog trotting along the path.
data.action: 牵着狗散步，晨光中笑容明媚
data.animaCaption: Her free hand waves toward the approaching viewer while the other holds the trotting dog's leash.
